items.prompt:
A variation is
A) a small difference among individuals of the same species
B) a kind of weather
C) a type of rock
D) a food
items.answer: A) a small difference among individuals of the same species

steps: Variations are differences among same-species individuals.

items.prompt:
A white rabbit in snow has an advantage because
A) predators see it easily
B) it blends in and is harder to see
C) it is slower
D) it glows
items.answer: B) it blends in and is harder to see

items.prompt:
Brighter feathers can help a male bird by
A) helping it attract a mate
B) making it slower
C) making it colder
D) doing nothing
items.answer: A) helping it attract a mate

items.prompt:
Which is an advantage a variation can provide?
A) Surviving better
B) Changing the weather
C) Making rocks
D) Nothing

steps: Helpful variations aid survival, mating, and reproduction.

items.prompt:
A faster cheetah has an advantage because it
A) catches more prey
B) sleeps more
C) is easier to see
D) cannot run

steps: Catching more prey helps it survive.

items.prompt:
In a dry area, a plant with deeper roots can
A) reach water shallow roots cannot
B) fly
C) make its own rain
D) stop growing
items.answer: A) reach water shallow roots cannot

steps: Deeper roots reach water in dry conditions.

items.prompt:
A brown rabbit in a snowy area is at a disadvantage because
A) it blends in
B) it stands out and is easier for predators to spot
C) it runs faster
D) it glows
items.answer: B) it stands out and is easier for predators to spot

steps: Standing out makes it easier to be caught.

items.prompt:
Which is the BEST evidence-based explanation?
A) A moth that matches tree bark is harder for birds to see, so it survives better
B) Moths are pretty
C) All moths are the same
D) Color never matters
items.answer: A) A moth that matches tree bark is harder for birds to see, so it survives better

steps: It uses a variation and evidence to explain a survival advantage.
